items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I replaced Sid Catlett in Boston to play George Wein's Storyville... It's the same way that I used to do with Sid Catlett. We used to sit down and rehearse different things

ctx.x: He's one of the great young ones, don't you think?

Yes, because at the particular time when Sid Catlett and I - I replaced Sid Catlett in Boston to play George Wein's Storyville. When we looked at Aldan - 'cause we always tried to find a replacement for us, all throughout the United States. As you know, you had a little cousin that I tried to do something. He played with Lester Young. O.K.?
